name: Underwater city
desc: a drowned civilisation on the sea floor, for exploration and for what outlasted people
tags: sunken city on the sea floor, coral encrusted stone towers, broken colonnades, shafts of light from the surface above, drifting silt, schools of fish between the buildings, swaying kelp, sand drifted over the streets
prose: a sunken city on the sea floor, its stone towers and broken colonnades crusted with coral, shafts of light falling from the surface far above, schools of fish drifting between the buildings and sand banked over the streets
note: Without water-borne nouns this is simply a city - the water has to be visible as THINGS: light shafts from above, drifting silt, fish, swaying kelp. Coral growing on the stonework is the single strongest cue. Pair with the underwater look and let the blue come from the grade; asking the prompt for 'blue water' does nothing measurable.
